subject: Pilot wrap: performance highlights + permission to publish a 60s customer quote
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lin <sophie@brightlane.ai>
Cc: James Taylor <james.t@brightlane.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap: performance highlights + permission to publish a 60s customer quote

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week recommendation pilot. We finished collecting the final metrics this morning and I wanted to share a short snapshot and a quick ask: would BrightLane be comfortable with a 30–60 second quote (text or a short audio clip) we can use in a customer highlight? We would of course share the draft attribution and recording for approval.

Snapshot from the pilot (week-over-week vs. BrightLane baseline):
- Conversion lift on targeted offers: +13.6% absolute (p < 0.01)
- Average cart value for variant users: +8.4%
- CPU token cost per session (after batching & KV cache): down 42% vs. your prior endpoint
- 95th percentile latency (400-token window): 245ms

Attachments: brightlane-pilot-kpis-20261011.pdf (charts + methodology), proposed 15s script stubs.

If you’re okay in principle, a one-line attribution like the feel below would be great — or we can record a quick 40s clip over Zoom if preferred.

Suggested quote (editable):
"Redwood helped us increase targeted conversions by 13% while lowering inference costs — the integration was straightforward and performant."

Proposed next steps:
1) If you approve, send back a one-line quote (or an audio clip) and any do-not-say constraints.
2) We’ll prepare a draft 1-paragraph case snippet and attribution for your review.
3) We’ll route to legal if needed (I’ve cc’d James).

No rush — if it’s easier I can also take the lead and stage a 10–15 min recording session next week.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0178

--
Attachment: brightlane-pilot-kpis-20261011.pdf (PDF, 2.6MB)
From: Sophie Lin <sophie@brightlane.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: James Taylor <james.t@brightlane.ai>, ops@brightlane.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap: performance highlights + permission to publish a 60s customer quote

Thanks Mateo — great summary and nice work to your engineering team. The numbers look accurate to what we saw in our dashboards.

We’re happy to help with a short customer blurb. James and I discussed internally and we can provide this one-liner (feel free to tweak for length/flow):

"Redwood’s inference platform drove a measurable lift in our targeted offers while reducing per-request cost — enabling us to scale recommendations without a heavy infra lift."

Attribution: BrightLane / Sophie Lin, Head of Product.

We’re okay with an edited version for brevity; please share the draft before publishing. Also fine with a short recorded clip — Sophie can do 30–45s on Tue or Wed next week.

Two quick constraints from legal/ops:
- Don’t reference absolute customer counts or revenue impact (we’ll only permit % lifts).
- Do not use BrightLane customer logos in any paid ads without a separate logo license.

Happy to sign a quick permission form — attach and we’ll return.

— Sophie
Sophie Lin
Head of Product, BrightLane
sophie@brightlane.ai

Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot wrap: performance highlights + permission to publish a 60s customer quote

Folks — forwarding Sophie’s reply from BrightLane. They approved a one-liner and are okay to record a short clip Tue/Wed. They attached two constraints (no absolute revenue, no logos in paid ads).

Attached: brightlane-30s-quote-audio.mp3 (Sophie to record), signed-permission-form.pdf (placeholder — will upload once they return). Also attaching the KPI deck I sent (brightlane-pilot-kpis-20261011.pdf).

Ask: Can product marketing draft a 1-paragraph customer highlight and a shortened one-line pull quote for our site? Also need legal to confirm the two constraints are sufficient for us to proceed without a longer license. Karthik — if you’re okay with the tone below, I’ll send the final draft to Sophie for sign-off.

Proposed short blurb (for review):
"BrightLane reduced inference cost per session and saw a 13% lift in targeted offers after integrating Redwood’s recommendation serving — enabling scale with predictable latency and lower infra overhead."

If marketing is good with this, I can attach the signed permission and publish once they approve the final draft.

Thanks,
Mateo

--
Attachments: brightlane-pilot-kpis-20261011.pdf, brightlane-30s-quote-audio.mp3 (audio, 35s), signed-permission-form.pdf (to be returned)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot wrap: performance highlights + permission to publish a 60s customer quote

Thanks for the forward — great outcomes. Marketing: the proposed blurb is fine but suggest tightening the first clause for website headlines. Proposed edit below; keep the metrics in the long-form case study and limit the homepage pull to the one-liner.

Homepage pull suggestion:
"Redwood helped BrightLane increase targeted conversions while cutting inference costs."

Long-form (case study intro) — keep your paragraph as-is, Mateo. Legal: please confirm the two constraints are acceptable; if so we can proceed with the quick permission form. Mateo — go ahead and schedule a 15-min recording with Sophie Tue 10:30am PT (I’ll join if needed).

LGTM from my side.

— Karthik
Head of Product Marketing, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
